hero.subtitle: Basic sample for your product. Replace the bracketed fields and verify with a lawyer in your jurisdiction.

s1.title: What data we collect
s1.work_text: prompts, negative prompts, parameters, uploaded references, generated images, action history.
s1.tech_text: IP, browser headers, language, user agent, timings, log events, session identifiers.
s1.storage_text: theme settings, last tab, session tokens.
s1.payments_text: tokens/identifiers from the provider. Payment details are with the provider, not with us.

s2.title: Why we process it
s2.service: Service delivery: auth, generation, history display, settings storage.
s2.improve: Product improvement: aggregated statistics and diagnostics.

s3.title: Legal bases
s3.contract: Performance of a contract — core functionality of the service.
s3.legitimate: Legitimate interest — security and basic analytics.
s3.obligation: Legal obligation — when required by law.

s4.title: Sharing with third parties
s4.note: We transfer the minimum, sign DPAs, and forbid secondary use.

s5.title: Retention periods
s5.account: Account — while the account is active.
s5.history: Generation history — until you delete it or up to [term/quota].
s5.backups: Backups — according to the retention cycle of [N] days.

s6.title: User rights
s6.list3: Withdrawal of consent, if the basis is consent.

s7.title: Security
s7.note: Absolute protection does not exist. We operate on data minimization principles.

s8.title: International transfers
s8.text: If data leaves your country/the EU — we use Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) and additional measures.

s9.title: Children
s9.text: The service is not intended for persons under [13/16]. If incompatible use is found — contact us and we will delete it.

s10.title: Cookies and local storage
s10.optional: Optional — only if enabled by you. Manage in settings and in your browser.

s11.title: Policy changes
s11.text: We update as the product evolves. Material changes — notice in the interface / by email.
